The recorded blocker ('needs the pixel_format PFD table') was stale: PFDTable is in the port (pixel_format_table.cpp) and its rows name the cases - 5 is R5G6B5 (0xf800/0x07e0/0x001f), 8 is A1R5G5B5 (0x7c00/0x03e0/0x001f plus 0x8000), and 12/13/14 are the 32-bit rows. Measured byte at buffer offset 0: format 12 gives FF 12 34 56 (component 3 first), 13 gives 56 FF 12 34 (component 2 first), 14 gives 34 56 FF 12 (component 1 first), with a=comp0 0x12, b=comp1 0x34, c=comp2 0x56, r=comp3 0xFF. Formats 5 and 8 pack one halfword and replicate it into both halves of the word. m_dataSize is a byte count for every format (format 5 at 8x8 measures 128). The write loop is m_dataSize >> 5 passes of eight words plus (m_dataSize >> 2) & 7 words, confirmed in the listing (eight STR at 0x5ffa3c..0x5ffa58, ADD R3,#0x20 at 0x5ffa5c, UBFX R3,R12,#2,#3 at 0x5ffa68); a block smaller than one word (a 1x1 16-bit image, 2 bytes) therefore writes nothing, and any format outside the five writes nothing.
